notes.title: New Challenge Update!
notes.content:
What's New?
[list]
[*]🧗 A New Difficult Climb – Brace yourself for an intense new ascent featuring fresh obstacles, strong winds, and plenty of ways to fall all the way back down.

[*]🎶 New Music – Immerse yourself in the climb with brand-new tracks that perfectly capture the "I'm about to lose my mind" experience.

[*]🏆 5 New Achievements – Because nothing says "suffering" like more achievements to grind for. Will you be among the few who unlock them all?

[*]🔥 More Rage Moments – Fails, falls, and heartbreaking resets await. If you thought the original climb tested your patience, this update takes things to a whole new level.
[/list]

Get ready to climb, fall, rage, and (maybe) conquer. Let us know what you think in the comments, and don’t forget to share your most spectacular fails!😂
See you at the top… or the bottom.

- RAZE GAMES

notes.title: indie.io - Official Publisher Announcement!
notes.content:
For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio?snr=1_5_9_]indie.io's Steam Publisher Page.
[/url]
Raze Games is super happy to be working with Indie.Io as it will allow our small team to focus on what we do best - making our best games!

We’re thrilled to announce that indie.io is the publisher of our games (and we’re honored they chose us too – thank you, indie.io!). There are several reasons why we partnered with them:

[list]
[*]We deeply admire indie.io’s diverse portfolio of indie games, which features a fantastic mix of casual and serious titles spanning genres like strategy, simulation, adventure, and more. We believe Yet Another Climbing Game will be a great addition to their lineup and hope to connect with gamers who love these styles!
[*]indie.io gives us the creative freedom to bring our vision to life and create the games we’re passionate about. They don’t dictate what we should make; instead, they support us in making our games the best they can be and ensuring they reach a wider audience.
[*]Here’s a fun fact: indie.io also operates Wiki.GG, an amazing platform for game wikis! We’re excited to partner with Wiki.GG to bring you the Yet Another Climbing Game Wiki. If you enjoy exploring game lore and details, check out Wiki.GG—it might even have a page for your favorite game!
[/list]
[url=https://www.wiki.gg/]Check out Wiki.GG!
[/url]
Looking ahead, we’re thrilled to partner with indie.io! This collaboration is an incredible milestone for our small studio, Raze Games. Working with such an amazing publisher will help us grow as developers and deliver authentic, unforgettable gaming experiences.

Don’t forget to wishlist Donna: The Canine Quest!, Yet Another Climbing Game, and follow us on social media to stay updated on future announcements.

Thanks for your support, and a big shoutout to our friends at indie.io for joining us on this exciting journey!

Happy gaming,
Raze Games
